featured.title: Why is Hong Kong so hot in October and will winter be warmer than usual?
featured.summary: Hong Kong’s exceptionally warm October weather is being driven by a combination of a super typhoon, El Nino and global warming, a climate expert has said, warning that higher-than-usual temperatures are likely to persist through the winter. The warning came as autumn temperatures across the city topped 30 degrees Celsius (86 Fahrenheit) over the past few weeks. Professor Amos Tai Pui-kuen, of the earth and environmental sciences department at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, explained on...
tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
featured.titleZh: 为何香港10月天气如此炎热？今年冬天会比往年更暖吗？
featured.summaryZh: 气候专家指出，受超强台风、厄尔尼诺现象和全球变暖的共同影响，香港10月气温异常偏高。专家警告称，这种高于往年的气温趋势可能会持续整个冬季。
featured.whyImportant: 气候异常现象对城市生活及公共卫生提出了新的挑战。

featured.title: Firefighters voice growing concerns over water supplies to tackle UK wildfires
featured.summary: During a summer fire that destroyed homes in Stourbridge, low pressure meant filling a water carrier took 40 minutes Concerns have been raised about how drought affects the UK’s ability to cope with wildfires after MPs were told firefighters struggled for water supplies during this year’s record summer. The government has been urged to set out water companies’ statutory responsibilities during major fire incidents to improve the country’s preparedness for the years ahead. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
featured.titleZh: 消防员对英国应对野火的水源供应表示担忧
featured.summaryZh: 今年夏季的极端干旱导致英国多地野火频发，消防部门在灭火过程中面临严重的水源短缺问题。相关部门呼吁政府明确水务公司在重大火灾中的法定责任，以提升国家应对能力。
featured.whyImportant: 气候变化带来的极端天气正考验英国基础设施的韧性，迫使政府重新评估应急资源配置。

The Jackdaw gasfield will be given the go-ahead on Wednesday, signalling Andy Burnham’s commitment to the North Sea fossil fuel industry and threatening to trigger a row with climate campaigners and Labour MPs. Miatta Fahnbulleh and John Healey, the energy secretary and chancellor respectively, will make the announcement from Aberdeen on Wednesday morning after more than a year of deliberations over whether doing so would violate the UK’s climate commitments. featured.titleZh: 安迪·伯纳姆批准北海天然气钻探，面临气候抗议压力
featured.summaryZh: 英国政府宣布批准开发Jackdaw天然气田，此举旨在支持北海化石燃料产业。该决定引发了气候活动人士及工党议员的强烈不满，质疑其是否违背了英国的气候承诺。
featured.whyImportant: 此举凸显了英国在能源安全需求与实现净零排放目标之间的政策矛盾。

global.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla exploring largest merger in history
global.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla Inc have formed special committees to explore a potential merger, a preliminary step towards what would rank as the largest corporate tie-up of all time. “I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining the companies,” Musk, the chief executive officer of both companies, said on Tuesday on SpaceX’s earnings webcast. “There’s a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software.” Musk said he is not taking part in the committee discussions...
global.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克称SpaceX与特斯拉正在探索史上最大规模合并
global.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX与特斯拉已成立特别委员会，探讨两家公司合并的可能性。马斯克认为，双方在开发超级智能软件方面的合作将带来巨大收益。
global.whyImportant: 若合并成行，这将成为史上规模最大的企业合并案，并可能重塑全球科技与人工智能产业格局。

global.title: Police charge accused Brendan Nugent with additional offences – as it happened
global.summary: Independent MP’s condition remains critical on Wednesday after surgery to save her remaining leg ‘Deeply appalled’: politicians condemn alleged attack after Helen Haines critically injured Helen Haines, the principled MP respected across parliament Anthony Albanese has described the police interview on Tuesday with Brendan Nugent as “extensive” but that the motivation of the alleged “violent” attack against Helen Haines is still unknown. Certainly, it’s a reminder that the world is a more dangerous and divided place than it was a generation ago. But I think that Australians do want to see their politicians be able to go about their business, to be able to get something from the back of their car, for goodness sake. My side, every side included. We all have to recognise that politics has got more aggressive. The particular impact on women in politics … [They] have got a different form of vilification and aggression towards them as well. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 警方对涉案嫌疑人布伦丹·纽金特追加指控——事件回顾
global.summaryZh: 独立议员海伦·海恩斯在遭受暴力袭击后伤势严重，目前仍处于危急状态。澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯谴责了此次袭击，并指出政坛日益激进的氛围令人担忧。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了对政界女性安全及政治环境日益恶化问题的广泛关注与讨论。

global.titleZh: 意大利批准全面安全措施以应对抗议活动
global.summaryZh: 针对近期发生的抗议与冲突，意大利政府已批准向米兰派遣500名士兵以维护治安。
global.whyImportant: 政府采取军事化手段应对国内抗议，反映了意大利当前社会动荡与治安压力的加剧。

global.title: A student protest movement has gripped Serbia for two years. This weekend it will try to take power
global.summary: Unorthodox campaign is challenging the ruling party’s 12-year reign with a bold democratic experiment On a cool autumn evening, a team of Serbian student volunteers went canvassing in the housing estates of Krnjača, a Belgrade suburb. They were equipped with lanyards emblazoned with the word “victory”, a stock list of questions and a mobile app that mapped visited homes and the level of support in each. The volunteers were part of a mass student movement, Student List, that has rocked Serbia with two years of constant protests. On Sunday, the group will represent the most serious challenge Aleksandar Vučić has faced in his 12 increasingly authoritarian years in power, by putting forward their own candidates in parliamentary elections. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 塞尔维亚学生抗议运动持续两年，本周末将尝试夺取政权
global.summaryZh: 由学生组成的“学生名单”运动在过去两年中持续抗议，现已正式推举候选人参加议会选举。这将是亚历山大·武契奇执政12年来面临的最严峻挑战。
global.whyImportant: 此次选举被视为塞尔维亚民主进程的关键时刻，可能改变该国长期的政治格局。

global.title: Fifth foreign firm pulls out of controversial Israeli cable car project to East Jerusalem
global.summary: Rights groups say the planned 1.4km route, which ends at compound run by far-right settler group Elad, will displace Palestinians and reshape the cultural landscape A fifth foreign company has pulled out of a plan to build a cable car from West to East Jerusalem that threatens to involve the seizure of land and property rights from dozens of Palestinian families along its route, but local authorities insist the scheme is proceeding as planned. The project appeared to have stalled for four years until late September, just weeks before Israel’s 27 October elections, when the Jerusalem Development Authority (JDA) issued a notice of intent to award a contract without a public tender to ROPES, a cable car engineering consultancy based in South Tyrol, Italy. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 第五家外国公司退出争议性的东耶路撒冷缆车项目
global.summaryZh: 因涉及土地征用及对巴勒斯坦社区的影响，第五家外国公司宣布退出东耶路撒冷缆车项目。尽管面临国际压力和法律争议，当地政府仍坚持推进该计划。
global.whyImportant: 该项目因涉及敏感的领土与文化遗产争议，持续引发国际社会对巴以局势的关注。

global.title: US troops in South Korea must be ready for missions beyond peninsula, commander says
global.summary: The commander of the US Eighth Army in South Korea said his troops must be ready for deployment outside the Korean peninsula if ordered, arguing that it would be “irresponsible” to focus “myopically” on threats there. Lieutenant General Joe Hilbert said that while his command’s focus was on fulfilling US commitments under its mutual defence treaty with Seoul, the Eighth Army’s location did not limit the missions it could undertake. It would be “irresponsible to focus myopically” on threats on...
global.titleZh: 美军指挥官称驻韩美军必须为半岛以外的任务做好准备
global.summaryZh: 驻韩美军第八集团军司令乔·希尔伯特表示，美军不能仅局限于应对半岛威胁，必须随时准备执行全球部署任务。他强调，这种准备是履行美韩共同防御条约之外的必要考量。
global.whyImportant: 此表态暗示美军在印太地区的战略部署正趋于灵活化，可能引发地区地缘政治的进一步解读。

global.title: Italy to deploy 500 troops to Milan after days of protests and looting
global.summary: Government planning tougher security measures as France also says military forces will be deployed Why are people protesting across Europe? Italy’s government is sending 500 soldiers to Milan and vowed a “firm response from the state” after protests against the cost of living descended into clashes with police, vandalism and looting. Further demonstrations are planned on Saturday. The government of the far-right prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, also announced new security measures, including an offence of violent participation in ⁠a demonstration, tougher penalties for ⁠rioters, and financial liability for ​parents whose children take part in vandalism and looting. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 意大利将在米兰部署500名士兵以应对持续的抗议和抢劫
global.summaryZh: 意大利政府宣布向米兰部署500名士兵，以应对因生活成本问题引发的抗议、破坏和抢劫活动。政府同时出台了更严厉的安保措施，包括对暴力示威者加重处罚，并要求父母对参与破坏活动的子女承担经济责任。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了欧洲多国在通胀压力下，政府为维护社会秩序而采取的强硬安全立场。

global.title: Singaporean parents jailed after 8-month-old son dies from severe abuse
global.summary: A Singaporean couple who regularly abused their first child after he was born, resulting in his death at the age of eight months, were sentenced to jail on Wednesday. Chloe Gan Ci Xuan, 23, and Neo Jia Ming, 27, were sentenced respectively to 15 years and three months’ jail and 16 years’ jail for various charges over the death of their son, Trevor Neo Yu Hin. Gan pleaded guilty to three charges comprising causing the death of a child, ill-treating a child and permitting such ill-treatment. Neo...
global.titleZh: 新加坡一对父母因虐待8个月大儿子致死被判入狱
global.summaryZh: 新加坡一对年轻夫妇因长期虐待其8个月大的儿子导致其死亡，于周三被判入狱。两人分别被判处15年零3个月以及16年监禁，罪名包括虐待儿童及导致儿童死亡等。
global.whyImportant: 该案件引发了公众对儿童保护机制及家庭暴力问题的广泛关注。

china.summary: Malaysia is negotiating with Thailand, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia to establish overland transit routes for fresh durian exports to China, according to Agriculture and Food Security Minister Mohamad Sabu. The minister said the move would reduce transport costs and improve access to the lucrative Chinese market. “Durian is a favourite among Chinese consumers, but they sometimes find it difficult to get the fruit at a more affordable price,” he said during parliament’s question and answer time on...
china.titleZh: 马来西亚寻求通过陆路运输促进对华榴莲贸易
china.summaryZh: 马来西亚农业和粮食安全部长表示，正与泰国、老挝、越南和柬埔寨协商建立陆路运输路线，以向中国出口新鲜榴莲。此举旨在降低运输成本，使中国消费者能以更实惠的价格购买榴莲。
china.whyImportant: 优化物流渠道有助于加强区域贸易联系并满足中国市场对农产品的需求。

china.title: China builds the world’s smallest wearable brain monitor with a cortex-wide view
china.summary: Chinese scientists have developed what they say is the world’s smallest wearable mini brain monitor that can track the activity of thousands of neurons at the same time. Weighing in at one gram (0.35 oz), the wireless “Airscope” is the lightest device of its kind and enables researchers to track a wider range of brain activity in untethered laboratory animals. The device was jointly developed by scientists from Tsinghua University and the Chinese PLA Medical School, and detailed in a paper...
china.titleZh: 中国研发出全球最小的可穿戴式大脑监测仪，可实现全皮层观测
china.summaryZh: 中国科学家开发出一款名为“Airscope”的无线大脑监测仪，重量仅为1克，是同类设备中最轻的。该设备能同时追踪数千个神经元的活动，为实验室动物的大脑研究提供了更广阔的视野。
china.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为神经科学研究提供了更高效、更轻便的实验工具。

china.title: Only 3% of Hong Kong firms have fully integrated AI into workflows, survey finds
china.summary: Only 3 per cent of Hong Kong companies have fully integrated AI into their workflows, with many facing hurdles including resistance to organisational change and outdated digital infrastructure, a survey has found. Consultancy Accenture, which polled 150 companies and released the results on Wednesday, said the survey suggested businesses had a strong desire to adopt artificial intelligence (AI) in their work but many struggled to put it into practice. “Hong Kong really has strong AI ambitions...
china.titleZh: 调查显示仅3%的香港企业将人工智能完全整合到工作流程中
china.summaryZh: 埃森哲的一项调查发现，尽管香港企业对人工智能有强烈的应用意愿，但仅有3%的企业实现了工作流程的全面整合。组织变革阻力和过时的数字基础设施是企业面临的主要障碍。
china.whyImportant: 这揭示了香港企业在数字化转型过程中，从意愿到实际落地仍存在显著差距。

china.title: China university offers course pushing students to call strangers to build confidence, social skills
china.summary: An unconventional course at prestigious Nanjing University encourages students to call strangers to hone their social skills, challenging the traditional value of “do more, speak less”. At the top-tier institution in Jiangsu province, eastern China, former television producer and director Xu Kai launched a course called “Oral Expression” in 2015. Over the years, it has become one of the students’ favourite public courses. The course includes a legendary assignment: students must call a stranger...
china.titleZh: 中国高校开设课程鼓励学生致电陌生人以建立自信和社交技能
china.summaryZh: 南京大学开设了一门名为“口语表达”的公共课程，鼓励学生通过给陌生人打电话来锻炼社交能力。这一课程挑战了传统的“多做少说”观念，成为学生中最受欢迎的课程之一。
china.whyImportant: 该课程反映了高校在培养学生综合素质和社交自信方面的创新尝试。

usa.titleZh: 美国特使将在俄罗斯会见普京，泽连斯基称情报共享“目前有效”
usa.summaryZh: 乌克兰此前曾指责美国扣留关键情报，但华盛顿驳斥了这一说法。目前泽连斯基表示情报共享机制已经开始发挥作用，同时美国特使计划前往俄罗斯进行会晤。
usa.whyImportant: 情报共享机制的改善对俄乌冲突的动态发展具有重要影响。

usa.title: Congressional Bills H.R. 227, H.R. 837, H.R. 1721, H.R. 2388, H.R. 2481, H.R. 3620, H.R. 4307, H.R. 4467, H.R. 6380, and H.R. 7831 Signed into Law
usa.summary: On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the President signed into law: H.R. 227, the “Clergy Act,” which allows a 2-year period in which ministers of a church, members of a religious order, and Christian Science practitioners may submit an application to the Internal Revenue Service to revoke their exemption from Social Security coverage; H.R. 837, which […] The post Congressional Bills H.R. 227, H.R. 837, H.R. 1721, H.R. 2388, H.R. 2481, H.R. 3620, H.R. 4307, H.R. 4467, H.R. 6380, and H.R. 7831 Signed into Law appeared first on The White House.
usa.titleZh: 美国国会法案 H.R. 227 等十项法案正式签署成为法律
usa.summaryZh: 2026年10月20日，美国总统签署了包括《神职人员法案》（H.R. 227）在内的十项法案。该法案允许教会牧师及相关宗教人员在两年内申请撤销其社会保障豁免权。
usa.whyImportant: 这些法案的签署标志着多项涉及社会保障及其他行政领域的立法正式生效。

usa.title: Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge
usa.summary: The lawsuit argues the White House exceeded its authority in imposing the latest tariffs on the country and caused "immediate harm to American businesses".

usa.summaryZh: 一项最新诉讼指控白宫在对加拿大征收关税时越权。原告认为此举对美国企业造成了直接损害。
usa.whyImportant: 此诉讼反映了贸易政策调整引发的法律争议及其对国内商业环境的影响。

usa.title: Chinese military vessels and spy drones track Keen Sword war games off Japan
usa.summary: Japan says it has spotted PLA aircraft, spy drones and warships, including a supply ship that could support the Liaoning aircraft carrier, in recent days as Tokyo and Washington started drills focused on a potential Taiwan contingency. Three People’s Liberation Army military aircraft – two drones and a reconnaissance plane – flew through international airspace between Japanese islands into the Pacific before heading back towards mainland China on Monday, prompting Japan to scramble fighter jets,...
usa.titleZh: 中国军舰与侦察无人机跟踪日本周边的“利剑”军演
usa.summaryZh: 日本方面近期发现中国解放军的军机、侦察无人机及军舰在周边海域活动。此次活动正值美日举行针对潜在台湾突发状况的联合军演期间。
usa.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了印太地区地缘政治紧张局势的加剧及军事对峙的常态化。

usa.title: Delivering for North Carolina: Safer Streets, Bigger Paychecks, and a Manufacturing Boom Under President Trump
usa.summary: President Donald J. Trump returns to North Carolina today with a clear record of results that put Tar Heel families, workers, seniors, and communities first. Since taking office, the Trump Administration has driven down crime, returned money to workers’ and seniors’ pockets, and unleashed a surge of advanced manufacturing, pharmaceutical, aerospace, biotechnology, and SI investment […] The post Delivering for North Carolina: Safer Streets, Bigger Paychecks, and a Manufacturing Boom Under President Trump appeared first on The White House.
usa.titleZh: 造福北卡罗来纳州：特朗普政府下的街道安全、薪资增长与制造业繁荣
usa.summaryZh: 特朗普总统重申其政府在北卡罗来纳州的执政成果，强调通过降低犯罪率和促进制造业投资，改善了当地家庭与工人的生活。政府声称在生物技术、航空航天等领域实现了显著增长。
usa.whyImportant: 此声明旨在展示政府的经济与治安政策成效，以巩固其在关键选区的支持率。

watch.title: University of Arizona sorority member alleges sexual assault at fraternity house
watch.summary: Student told the university’s police department that assault by two men occurred in August during a night of drinking A sorority member at the University of Arizona has alleged she was sexually assaulted by two men at a fraternity house during a night of drinking in late August. The student told the university’s police department that she consensually kissed one of the men at one point while at the Sigma Phi Epsilon house on 26 August but doesn’t remember agreeing to sex, according to search warrant records posted Monday night by KOLD-TV in Tucson. Continue reading...
watch.titleZh: 亚利桑那大学一名女生指控在兄弟会宿舍遭性侵
watch.summaryZh: 一名亚利桑那大学女生向校警报案，称其8月在参加聚会时遭两名男子性侵。根据搜查令记录，受害者表示不记得曾同意发生性行为。
watch.whyImportant: 该案件引发了对校园安全及兄弟会文化中性暴力问题的广泛关注。

watch.title: Burnham’s Britain can learn from Trump in engaging with China
watch.summary: Getting relations with China right is widely seen as Britain’s epoch-defining challenge. It is also one it is woefully unprepared to face. So concluded a recent audit by the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China (IPAC), which highlighted that top negotiators lacked basic Chinese language skills. More critically, it exposed a deeper deficit: a poor grasp of China spanning political elites and the public alike. This is rooted in a desk-bound classroom sinology rather than a nuanced appreciation...
watch.titleZh: 伯纳姆的英国可以学习特朗普与中国打交道的方式
watch.summaryZh: 文章指出英国在处理对华关系方面准备不足，缺乏必要的语言能力和深入理解。作者建议英国应借鉴特朗普政府在对华接触中的某些策略。
watch.whyImportant: 该评论探讨了英国在复杂国际环境下调整对华外交政策的必要性与路径。

watch.title: France is divided over who to blame for weekend riots and what to learn from them
watch.summary: In France and beyond there is widespread disagreement over what led to some of the worst unrest seen in French cities in modern history.
watch.titleZh: 法国对周末骚乱的责任归属及经验教训存在分歧
watch.summaryZh: 法国近期爆发了现代史上最严重的城市骚乱之一。目前，法国国内及国际社会对于骚乱的起因及应对措施仍存在广泛争议。
watch.whyImportant: 此次骚乱暴露了法国社会内部深层的矛盾，并引发了关于社会治理与政策反思的讨论。

items.title: Why is Hong Kong so hot in October and will winter be warmer than usual?
items.summary: Hong Kong’s exceptionally warm October weather is being driven by a combination of a super typhoon, El Nino and global warming, a climate expert has said, warning that higher-than-usual temperatures are likely to persist through the winter. The warning came as autumn temperatures across the city topped 30 degrees Celsius (86 Fahrenheit) over the past few weeks. Professor Amos Tai Pui-kuen, of the earth and environmental sciences department at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, explained on...
tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
items.titleZh: 为何香港10月天气如此炎热？今年冬天会比往年更暖吗？
items.summaryZh: 气候专家指出，受超强台风、厄尔尼诺现象和全球变暖的共同影响，香港10月气温异常偏高。专家警告称，这种高于往年的气温趋势可能会持续整个冬季。
items.whyImportant: 气候异常现象对城市生活及公共卫生提出了新的挑战。

items.title: Firefighters voice growing concerns over water supplies to tackle UK wildfires
items.summary: During a summer fire that destroyed homes in Stourbridge, low pressure meant filling a water carrier took 40 minutes Concerns have been raised about how drought affects the UK’s ability to cope with wildfires after MPs were told firefighters struggled for water supplies during this year’s record summer. The government has been urged to set out water companies’ statutory responsibilities during major fire incidents to improve the country’s preparedness for the years ahead. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
items.titleZh: 消防员对英国应对野火的水源供应表示担忧
items.summaryZh: 今年夏季的极端干旱导致英国多地野火频发，消防部门在灭火过程中面临严重的水源短缺问题。相关部门呼吁政府明确水务公司在重大火灾中的法定责任，以提升国家应对能力。
items.whyImportant: 气候变化带来的极端天气正考验英国基础设施的韧性，迫使政府重新评估应急资源配置。

items.title: Andy Burnham faces climate revolt after approval of North Sea gas drilling
items.summary: Jackdaw gasfield announcement signals UK’s commitment to North Sea industry but undermines green credentials What does the approval of the Jackdaw gasfield mean? The Jackdaw gasfield will be given the go-ahead on Wednesday, signalling Andy Burnham’s commitment to the North Sea fossil fuel industry and threatening to trigger a row with climate campaigners and Labour MPs. Miatta Fahnbulleh and John Healey, the energy secretary and chancellor respectively, will make the announcement from Aberdeen on Wednesday morning after more than a year of deliberations over whether doing so would violate the UK’s climate commitments. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
items.titleZh: 安迪·伯纳姆批准北海天然气钻探，面临气候抗议压力
items.summaryZh: 英国政府宣布批准开发Jackdaw天然气田，此举旨在支持北海化石燃料产业。该决定引发了气候活动人士及工党议员的强烈不满，质疑其是否违背了英国的气候承诺。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了英国在能源安全需求与实现净零排放目标之间的政策矛盾。

items.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla exploring largest merger in history
items.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla Inc have formed special committees to explore a potential merger, a preliminary step towards what would rank as the largest corporate tie-up of all time. “I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining the companies,” Musk, the chief executive officer of both companies, said on Tuesday on SpaceX’s earnings webcast. “There’s a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software.” Musk said he is not taking part in the committee discussions...
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克称SpaceX与特斯拉正在探索史上最大规模合并
items.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX与特斯拉已成立特别委员会，探讨两家公司合并的可能性。马斯克认为，双方在开发超级智能软件方面的合作将带来巨大收益。
items.whyImportant: 若合并成行，这将成为史上规模最大的企业合并案，并可能重塑全球科技与人工智能产业格局。

items.title: Police charge accused Brendan Nugent with additional offences – as it happened
items.summary: Independent MP’s condition remains critical on Wednesday after surgery to save her remaining leg ‘Deeply appalled’: politicians condemn alleged attack after Helen Haines critically injured Helen Haines, the principled MP respected across parliament Anthony Albanese has described the police interview on Tuesday with Brendan Nugent as “extensive” but that the motivation of the alleged “violent” attack against Helen Haines is still unknown. Certainly, it’s a reminder that the world is a more dangerous and divided place than it was a generation ago. But I think that Australians do want to see their politicians be able to go about their business, to be able to get something from the back of their car, for goodness sake. My side, every side included. We all have to recognise that politics has got more aggressive. The particular impact on women in politics … [They] have got a different form of vilification and aggression towards them as well. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 警方对涉案嫌疑人布伦丹·纽金特追加指控——事件回顾
items.summaryZh: 独立议员海伦·海恩斯在遭受暴力袭击后伤势严重，目前仍处于危急状态。澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯谴责了此次袭击，并指出政坛日益激进的氛围令人担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了对政界女性安全及政治环境日益恶化问题的广泛关注与讨论。

items.title: Italy approves sweeping security measures in response to protests
items.summary: Italy's government approves sending 500 troops to Milan after clashes and protests.
items.titleZh: 意大利批准全面安全措施以应对抗议活动
items.summaryZh: 针对近期发生的抗议与冲突，意大利政府已批准向米兰派遣500名士兵以维护治安。
items.whyImportant: 政府采取军事化手段应对国内抗议，反映了意大利当前社会动荡与治安压力的加剧。

items.title: A student protest movement has gripped Serbia for two years. This weekend it will try to take power
items.summary: Unorthodox campaign is challenging the ruling party’s 12-year reign with a bold democratic experiment On a cool autumn evening, a team of Serbian student volunteers went canvassing in the housing estates of Krnjača, a Belgrade suburb. They were equipped with lanyards emblazoned with the word “victory”, a stock list of questions and a mobile app that mapped visited homes and the level of support in each. The volunteers were part of a mass student movement, Student List, that has rocked Serbia with two years of constant protests. On Sunday, the group will represent the most serious challenge Aleksandar Vučić has faced in his 12 increasingly authoritarian years in power, by putting forward their own candidates in parliamentary elections. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 塞尔维亚学生抗议运动持续两年，本周末将尝试夺取政权
items.summaryZh: 由学生组成的“学生名单”运动在过去两年中持续抗议，现已正式推举候选人参加议会选举。这将是亚历山大·武契奇执政12年来面临的最严峻挑战。
items.whyImportant: 此次选举被视为塞尔维亚民主进程的关键时刻，可能改变该国长期的政治格局。

items.title: Fifth foreign firm pulls out of controversial Israeli cable car project to East Jerusalem
items.summary: Rights groups say the planned 1.4km route, which ends at compound run by far-right settler group Elad, will displace Palestinians and reshape the cultural landscape A fifth foreign company has pulled out of a plan to build a cable car from West to East Jerusalem that threatens to involve the seizure of land and property rights from dozens of Palestinian families along its route, but local authorities insist the scheme is proceeding as planned. The project appeared to have stalled for four years until late September, just weeks before Israel’s 27 October elections, when the Jerusalem Development Authority (JDA) issued a notice of intent to award a contract without a public tender to ROPES, a cable car engineering consultancy based in South Tyrol, Italy. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 第五家外国公司退出争议性的东耶路撒冷缆车项目
items.summaryZh: 因涉及土地征用及对巴勒斯坦社区的影响，第五家外国公司宣布退出东耶路撒冷缆车项目。尽管面临国际压力和法律争议，当地政府仍坚持推进该计划。
items.whyImportant: 该项目因涉及敏感的领土与文化遗产争议，持续引发国际社会对巴以局势的关注。

items.title: US troops in South Korea must be ready for missions beyond peninsula, commander says
items.summary: The commander of the US Eighth Army in South Korea said his troops must be ready for deployment outside the Korean peninsula if ordered, arguing that it would be “irresponsible” to focus “myopically” on threats there. Lieutenant General Joe Hilbert said that while his command’s focus was on fulfilling US commitments under its mutual defence treaty with Seoul, the Eighth Army’s location did not limit the missions it could undertake. It would be “irresponsible to focus myopically” on threats on...
items.titleZh: 美军指挥官称驻韩美军必须为半岛以外的任务做好准备
items.summaryZh: 驻韩美军第八集团军司令乔·希尔伯特表示，美军不能仅局限于应对半岛威胁，必须随时准备执行全球部署任务。他强调，这种准备是履行美韩共同防御条约之外的必要考量。
items.whyImportant: 此表态暗示美军在印太地区的战略部署正趋于灵活化，可能引发地区地缘政治的进一步解读。

items.title: Italy to deploy 500 troops to Milan after days of protests and looting
items.summary: Government planning tougher security measures as France also says military forces will be deployed Why are people protesting across Europe? Italy’s government is sending 500 soldiers to Milan and vowed a “firm response from the state” after protests against the cost of living descended into clashes with police, vandalism and looting. Further demonstrations are planned on Saturday. The government of the far-right prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, also announced new security measures, including an offence of violent participation in ⁠a demonstration, tougher penalties for ⁠rioters, and financial liability for ​parents whose children take part in vandalism and looting. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 意大利将在米兰部署500名士兵以应对持续的抗议和抢劫
items.summaryZh: 意大利政府宣布向米兰部署500名士兵，以应对因生活成本问题引发的抗议、破坏和抢劫活动。政府同时出台了更严厉的安保措施，包括对暴力示威者加重处罚，并要求父母对参与破坏活动的子女承担经济责任。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了欧洲多国在通胀压力下，政府为维护社会秩序而采取的强硬安全立场。

items.title: Singaporean parents jailed after 8-month-old son dies from severe abuse
items.summary: A Singaporean couple who regularly abused their first child after he was born, resulting in his death at the age of eight months, were sentenced to jail on Wednesday. Chloe Gan Ci Xuan, 23, and Neo Jia Ming, 27, were sentenced respectively to 15 years and three months’ jail and 16 years’ jail for various charges over the death of their son, Trevor Neo Yu Hin. Gan pleaded guilty to three charges comprising causing the death of a child, ill-treating a child and permitting such ill-treatment. Neo...
items.titleZh: 新加坡一对父母因虐待8个月大儿子致死被判入狱
items.summaryZh: 新加坡一对年轻夫妇因长期虐待其8个月大的儿子导致其死亡，于周三被判入狱。两人分别被判处15年零3个月以及16年监禁，罪名包括虐待儿童及导致儿童死亡等。
items.whyImportant: 该案件引发了公众对儿童保护机制及家庭暴力问题的广泛关注。

items.title: Stinking rich: Malaysia eyes land routes to boost durian trade in China
items.summary: Malaysia is negotiating with Thailand, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia to establish overland transit routes for fresh durian exports to China, according to Agriculture and Food Security Minister Mohamad Sabu. The minister said the move would reduce transport costs and improve access to the lucrative Chinese market. “Durian is a favourite among Chinese consumers, but they sometimes find it difficult to get the fruit at a more affordable price,” he said during parliament’s question and answer time on...
items.titleZh: 马来西亚寻求通过陆路运输促进对华榴莲贸易
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚农业和粮食安全部长表示，正与泰国、老挝、越南和柬埔寨协商建立陆路运输路线，以向中国出口新鲜榴莲。此举旨在降低运输成本，使中国消费者能以更实惠的价格购买榴莲。
items.whyImportant: 优化物流渠道有助于加强区域贸易联系并满足中国市场对农产品的需求。

items.title: China builds the world’s smallest wearable brain monitor with a cortex-wide view
items.summary: Chinese scientists have developed what they say is the world’s smallest wearable mini brain monitor that can track the activity of thousands of neurons at the same time. Weighing in at one gram (0.35 oz), the wireless “Airscope” is the lightest device of its kind and enables researchers to track a wider range of brain activity in untethered laboratory animals. The device was jointly developed by scientists from Tsinghua University and the Chinese PLA Medical School, and detailed in a paper...
items.titleZh: 中国研发出全球最小的可穿戴式大脑监测仪，可实现全皮层观测
items.summaryZh: 中国科学家开发出一款名为“Airscope”的无线大脑监测仪，重量仅为1克，是同类设备中最轻的。该设备能同时追踪数千个神经元的活动，为实验室动物的大脑研究提供了更广阔的视野。
items.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为神经科学研究提供了更高效、更轻便的实验工具。

items.title: Only 3% of Hong Kong firms have fully integrated AI into workflows, survey finds
items.summary: Only 3 per cent of Hong Kong companies have fully integrated AI into their workflows, with many facing hurdles including resistance to organisational change and outdated digital infrastructure, a survey has found. Consultancy Accenture, which polled 150 companies and released the results on Wednesday, said the survey suggested businesses had a strong desire to adopt artificial intelligence (AI) in their work but many struggled to put it into practice. “Hong Kong really has strong AI ambitions...
items.titleZh: 调查显示仅3%的香港企业将人工智能完全整合到工作流程中
items.summaryZh: 埃森哲的一项调查发现，尽管香港企业对人工智能有强烈的应用意愿，但仅有3%的企业实现了工作流程的全面整合。组织变革阻力和过时的数字基础设施是企业面临的主要障碍。
items.whyImportant: 这揭示了香港企业在数字化转型过程中，从意愿到实际落地仍存在显著差距。

items.title: China university offers course pushing students to call strangers to build confidence, social skills
items.summary: An unconventional course at prestigious Nanjing University encourages students to call strangers to hone their social skills, challenging the traditional value of “do more, speak less”. At the top-tier institution in Jiangsu province, eastern China, former television producer and director Xu Kai launched a course called “Oral Expression” in 2015. Over the years, it has become one of the students’ favourite public courses. The course includes a legendary assignment: students must call a stranger...
items.titleZh: 中国高校开设课程鼓励学生致电陌生人以建立自信和社交技能
items.summaryZh: 南京大学开设了一门名为“口语表达”的公共课程，鼓励学生通过给陌生人打电话来锻炼社交能力。这一课程挑战了传统的“多做少说”观念，成为学生中最受欢迎的课程之一。
items.whyImportant: 该课程反映了高校在培养学生综合素质和社交自信方面的创新尝试。

items.title: US envoy to meet Putin in Russia as Zelensky says intelligence sharing 'works now'
items.summary: Ukraine had accused the US of withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by Washington.
items.titleZh: 美国特使将在俄罗斯会见普京，泽连斯基称情报共享“目前有效”
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰此前曾指责美国扣留关键情报，但华盛顿驳斥了这一说法。目前泽连斯基表示情报共享机制已经开始发挥作用，同时美国特使计划前往俄罗斯进行会晤。
items.whyImportant: 情报共享机制的改善对俄乌冲突的动态发展具有重要影响。

items.title: Congressional Bills H.R. 227, H.R. 837, H.R. 1721, H.R. 2388, H.R. 2481, H.R. 3620, H.R. 4307, H.R. 4467, H.R. 6380, and H.R. 7831 Signed into Law
items.summary: On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the President signed into law: H.R. 227, the “Clergy Act,” which allows a 2-year period in which ministers of a church, members of a religious order, and Christian Science practitioners may submit an application to the Internal Revenue Service to revoke their exemption from Social Security coverage; H.R. 837, which […] The post Congressional Bills H.R. 227, H.R. 837, H.R. 1721, H.R. 2388, H.R. 2481, H.R. 3620, H.R. 4307, H.R. 4467, H.R. 6380, and H.R. 7831 Signed into Law appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 美国国会法案 H.R. 227 等十项法案正式签署成为法律
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月20日，美国总统签署了包括《神职人员法案》（H.R. 227）在内的十项法案。该法案允许教会牧师及相关宗教人员在两年内申请撤销其社会保障豁免权。
items.whyImportant: 这些法案的签署标志着多项涉及社会保障及其他行政领域的立法正式生效。

items.title: Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge
items.summary: The lawsuit argues the White House exceeded its authority in imposing the latest tariffs on the country and caused "immediate harm to American businesses".
items.titleZh: 特朗普因对加拿大征收关税面临法律挑战
items.summaryZh: 一项最新诉讼指控白宫在对加拿大征收关税时越权。原告认为此举对美国企业造成了直接损害。
items.whyImportant: 此诉讼反映了贸易政策调整引发的法律争议及其对国内商业环境的影响。

items.title: Chinese military vessels and spy drones track Keen Sword war games off Japan
items.summary: Japan says it has spotted PLA aircraft, spy drones and warships, including a supply ship that could support the Liaoning aircraft carrier, in recent days as Tokyo and Washington started drills focused on a potential Taiwan contingency. Three People’s Liberation Army military aircraft – two drones and a reconnaissance plane – flew through international airspace between Japanese islands into the Pacific before heading back towards mainland China on Monday, prompting Japan to scramble fighter jets,...
items.titleZh: 中国军舰与侦察无人机跟踪日本周边的“利剑”军演
items.summaryZh: 日本方面近期发现中国解放军的军机、侦察无人机及军舰在周边海域活动。此次活动正值美日举行针对潜在台湾突发状况的联合军演期间。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了印太地区地缘政治紧张局势的加剧及军事对峙的常态化。

items.title: Delivering for North Carolina: Safer Streets, Bigger Paychecks, and a Manufacturing Boom Under President Trump

items.titleZh: 造福北卡罗来纳州：特朗普政府下的街道安全、薪资增长与制造业繁荣
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统重申其政府在北卡罗来纳州的执政成果，强调通过降低犯罪率和促进制造业投资，改善了当地家庭与工人的生活。政府声称在生物技术、航空航天等领域实现了显著增长。
items.whyImportant: 此声明旨在展示政府的经济与治安政策成效，以巩固其在关键选区的支持率。

items.title: University of Arizona sorority member alleges sexual assault at fraternity house
items.summary: Student told the university’s police department that assault by two men occurred in August during a night of drinking A sorority member at the University of Arizona has alleged she was sexually assaulted by two men at a fraternity house during a night of drinking in late August. The student told the university’s police department that she consensually kissed one of the men at one point while at the Sigma Phi Epsilon house on 26 August but doesn’t remember agreeing to sex, according to search warrant records posted Monday night by KOLD-TV in Tucson. items.titleZh: 亚利桑那大学一名女生指控在兄弟会宿舍遭性侵
items.summaryZh: 一名亚利桑那大学女生向校警报案，称其8月在参加聚会时遭两名男子性侵。根据搜查令记录，受害者表示不记得曾同意发生性行为。
items.whyImportant: 该案件引发了对校园安全及兄弟会文化中性暴力问题的广泛关注。

items.title: Burnham’s Britain can learn from Trump in engaging with China
items.summary: Getting relations with China right is widely seen as Britain’s epoch-defining challenge. It is also one it is woefully unprepared to face. So concluded a recent audit by the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China (IPAC), which highlighted that top negotiators lacked basic Chinese language skills. More critically, it exposed a deeper deficit: a poor grasp of China spanning political elites and the public alike. This is rooted in a desk-bound classroom sinology rather than a nuanced appreciation...
items.titleZh: 伯纳姆的英国可以学习特朗普与中国打交道的方式
items.summaryZh: 文章指出英国在处理对华关系方面准备不足，缺乏必要的语言能力和深入理解。作者建议英国应借鉴特朗普政府在对华接触中的某些策略。
items.whyImportant: 该评论探讨了英国在复杂国际环境下调整对华外交政策的必要性与路径。

items.title: France is divided over who to blame for weekend riots and what to learn from them
items.summary: In France and beyond there is widespread disagreement over what led to some of the worst unrest seen in French cities in modern history.
items.titleZh: 法国对周末骚乱的责任归属及经验教训存在分歧
items.summaryZh: 法国近期爆发了现代史上最严重的城市骚乱之一。目前，法国国内及国际社会对于骚乱的起因及应对措施仍存在广泛争议。
items.whyImportant: 此次骚乱暴露了法国社会内部深层的矛盾，并引发了关于社会治理与政策反思的讨论。
